decisions.reason: A core next-generation high-resolution platform close to the established offer that was featured on the home page, with low carrying cost and continuing strategic value, so the option remains worth holding.
A cheap-to-maintain software module that supports the firm's serialization and variable-data strategy, so keeping it costs little while its value is still building.
A niche coder for non-absorbent surfaces that extends the established ink and technology expertise at modest cost; it had low visibility but there is no evidence its value has failed.
A low-cost mobile app that already succeeded PharmaScan and fits the digital traceability direction, though apps are often renamed or replaced, so some risk of being superseded remains.
Inline code verification is central to the end-to-end traceability strategy and complements the coding systems, so its option value is high.
Layout design software that provides common operation across systems was featured on the home page and is cheap to maintain, so it is worth keeping.
